summary: Implemented all five plan phases: the shared sapience-api-lib.sh (host/token resolution, authenticated POST/GET, token redaction, bounded cold-start retry), sapience-project-bind.sh (confirm-or-refuse fresh-project creation and .sapience/project.json writer, byte-identical to repo_link.py's link_text), and sapience-vault-read.sh (pinned read-only local+vault JSON envelope with per-source failure isolation). Both new scripts have passing test suites (27 and 19 assertions respectively), the extension manifest is regenerated (sapience: 16/16), and the lockstep worktree-resolution guard now compares all seven copies. One commit in this task's history carries a foreign, unrelated prior dispatch's hunk alongside this task's own change -- disclosed in detail in the summary and issue log.

artifacts.summary: All five plan phases completed: the shared sapience-api-lib.sh, the confirm-or-refuse project binder, the read-only vault aggregator, their two test suites, and the manifest/lockstep registration edits.
